age_floor_note: The 2022 cell's 0.0 is FLOORED AT ZERO, not data: 4 bucket(s) carry value-weighted origin dates after June 2022 (late-2022 originations dominate the bucket average), and negative as-of ages are clamped. The true 2022-vintage mean age at June 2022 is ~2-3 months; at the cell's 23.1% weight the difference moves the blend by under 0.05 years.
note: Ages derived from CUSIP-level origin dates (maturity − term, the production back-derivation), face-weighted within vintage cells, as-of the holdings file at run date — no reference to Table 6. Two disclosed limitations: (i) as-of drift — the June-2022 stock differs from today's surviving face by composition; (ii) origin dates are value-weighted within (term, coupon) buckets before cell assignment, which smears adjacent vintages (visible in the derived cell shares vs the printed tabulation), so the blend uses the PRINTED vintage face shares with the derived ages. The point of the exercise survives both: externally anchored ages give a scheduled-only blend within 0.3 years of the printed 14.7 and nowhere near 16-17.
